title: Lunch in the Canteen
story: Mateo carried his tray into the school canteen and looked for a free seat. The room was loud, and the smell of tomato soup was strong. He saw his friend Greta at a table by the window and walked over. Greta moved her bag so he could sit down. Mateo had soup, bread, and an apple. Greta had rice and a piece of chicken. They talked about the morning lessons while they ate. Mateo had found the science test difficult, and he was still thinking about one question. Greta said she had written the steps in her notebook, and she offered to show him after lunch. Mateo felt better at once. Halfway through the meal he knocked his cup with his elbow. Water ran across the table and toward Greta's notebook. He grabbed a paper napkin and stopped the water before it reached the pages. A canteen assistant called Rita brought a cloth and wiped the table. She told them spills happen every day and nobody needed to feel ashamed. Mateo thanked her and moved his cup farther from the edge. When the bell rang, the two friends put their trays on the rack by the door. Greta kept her promise and opened the notebook on a bench in the corridor. Mateo copied the science steps and understood the question at last. He was glad he had sat with a friend, and glad the notebook had stayed dry.
